prompts.name: 01-guandao
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished 1536x1024 landscape VFX CONCEPT DESIGN BOARD for the existing 2D top-down cartoon mobile game 桃园小英雄. This is a concept, not an engine screenshot. Match the referenced actual game character identities, big-head tiny-body chibi proportions, warm bold outlines and bright hand-painted grass with tiny flowers. Upgrade the effects to rich, translucent hand-painted anime materials with luminous cores, layered flowing shapes and tapered continuous ribbons as seen in the supplied video reference. Do not copy its dark vertical battlefield or adult realistic heroes. Composition: one large gameplay-view peak scene occupying the top 70%, bottom three equal panels showing the SAME attack's preparation / release-contact / dissipation at the same camera and scale. Very small tasteful jade title bar. Only these Chinese labels: top title as specified; below it small “特效概念稿”; bottom labels “起手” “释放” “收尾”. No other text, HUD, numbers, fake buttons, metrics, annotation arrows or watermarks. Keep ground and faces readable, localized highlights, no full-screen glow or darkening. Remove tiling seams from grass. No photorealism, no 3D rendering, no giant character portrait. Render tangible textured effects, not flat neon outline circles. Bottom sequence is designed keyframes, not three different skills. Reference1 is character 小关 and the in-game scale/style, Reference2 is VFX material/motion inspiration only. Title “青龙刀 · 青玉裂锋”. Small youth Guan Yu in green robe and green headscarf, gold trim, bright youthful face, holding the long green crescent guandao correctly in both hands with visible fists. No beard, no mount. Main scene: hero center-left drives a low sweeping crescent toward right, a broad solid translucent JADE blade surface with ivory cutting edge and subtle darker turquoise back edge, internal flowing grain, two tapered curved trailing ribbons; attack radius about two character heights. Three small yellow-bandana soldiers near the blade front, precisely two contacting enemies have local sharp white-green impact wedges and small directional gold fragments, recoil away; a fourth soldier OUTSIDE the sweep remains untouched. Clear difference between physical blade face and transparent fading tail, no complete glowing ring, no dragon giant head for every normal attack. Ground remains visible through the tail. Bottom: compressed torso and raised blade before swing; full blade/contact; short tapered remnants and settling chips with hero recovering. Frame-consistent weapon and anatomy.
